ui.village.merchant_away: The merchant isn't in the village; comes on shopping day.
ui.village.merchant_only: Brought by the travelling merchant: sold only on shopping day
ui.village.stock.sold_out: None left today; more comes tomorrow morning.
village.call.breakdown: {name} doesn't want to see anyone; console them first.
village.call.coming: {name}: "Coming, I'll open the shop for you."
village.call.not_home: {name} isn't home. The neighbours say they may be {where}.
village.closed.breakdown: The master is unwell; closed today.
village.closed.mourning: In mourning; the shop is closed today.
village.closed.rest_day: Sunday: the shop is closed. If you need the master, call at their home.
village.closed.sick: The master is sick; the shop is closed.
village.console.done: {name} feels a little better ({percent}% of the gloom has lifted).
village.console.ended: {name} has pulled through and will open the shop tomorrow.
village.console.go_home: You need to go to {name}'s home to console them.
village.console.not_needed: {name} seems fine; no need to console.
village.console.shared: You shared your grief with {name}; you both feel a little lighter.
village.console.too_young: You need to be a little older to console someone.
village.haggle.gloomy: {name} is in no mood to haggle today; the price stays.
village.line.cheerful.1: Oh, welcome! Everything's going well today.
village.line.cheerful.2: Look at this weather, it lifts the heart.
village.line.cheerful.3: Come sit a while, I've lots to tell you!
village.line.cheerful.4: My hands and my work both smiled today.
village.line.cheerful.5: Seeing you did me good, thank you.
village.line.cheerful.6: Drop by the tavern tonight, we'll sing a song.
village.line.gloomy.2: I'm not much for talking today.
village.line.gloomy.3: If only one day would go well...
village.line.gloomy.4: I've work to do, let's talk later.
village.line.neutral.3: Looks like the weather will turn, take care.
village.line.neutral.4: Tell me if you need anything.
village.loss.1: I lost someone close not long ago, too: {name}.
village.loss.2: So you too... I didn't know. Come, sit.
village.n.closed_breakdown: {name} closed the shop early and went home.
village.n.reopened: {name} has recovered; the shop is open again.
village.req.cold.text: {name}: "We're out of firewood and so cold. Could you bring some?"
village.req.cold.title: The hearth has gone out
village.req.hunger.text: {name}: "There's nothing left in the pantry. Could you find a few loaves?"
village.req.hunger.title: The pantry is empty
village.treat.any.1: Here you go, I'm in a good mood today!
village.treat.any.2: This one's on me, say hello to your mother.
village.treat.any.4: My heart's glad, may your purse be too.
village.treat.any.5: It's a bountiful day, let's share.
village.treat.any.6: You're a good neighbour, take this.
village.treat.blacksmith.1: Take this horseshoe, hang it on your door; it brings luck.
village.treat.blacksmith.2: The forge burned well today, this one's on me.
village.treat.blacksmith.3: Stay strong as iron, here you go.
village.treat.carpenter.1: A spoon from the offcuts, take it.
village.treat.carpenter.2: My hands are warmed up, this one's a gift.
village.treat.carpenter.3: Wood and people both smile today.
village.treat.fisher.1: Take a crayfish for your supper.
village.treat.fisher.2: The nets came in full today, let's share.
village.treat.fisher.3: The lake was generous, so I'll be too.
village.treat.herbalist.1: A pinch of mint, brew it and drink.
village.treat.herbalist.2: This herb will do you good, don't ask the price.
village.treat.innkeeper.2: The tavern's merry today, be merry too!
village.treat.innkeeper.3: The evening soup is on your side too.
village.treat.mason.1: Take this whetstone, keep your tools sharp.
village.treat.mason.2: The stone carved like butter today.
village.treat.mason.3: Sturdy house, sturdy heart, this one's on me.
village.treat.miller.2: Good flour, good mood; this one's on me.
village.treat.miller.3: Say hello to your mother, this is her share.
village.treat.potter.1: This cup came out a bit crooked, but it means well.
village.treat.potter.2: The wheel turned sweetly today, take this.
village.treat.potter.3: A little keepsake for your home.
village.treat.saddler.1: I gave you a discount, keep it quiet.
village.treat.saddler.2: The leather and my mood are both soft today.
village.treat.scribe.1: Take a parchment, write something nice.
village.treat.scribe.3: A gift for one who reads and writes.
village.treat.shepherd.1: The flock behaved today, take this cheese.
village.treat.shepherd.2: Fresh, it tastes of the high pasture.
village.treat.shepherd.3: I'm merry as the lambs, this one's on me.
village.treat.tailor.1: Take a button, keep it in your pocket.
village.treat.tailor.2: Needle and thread got along well today.
village.treat.tailor.3: Keep yourself neat, this one's on me.
village.treat.trader.1: Have an apple for the road.
village.treat.trader.2: Good earnings today, a little for you.
village.work.throw_pot: throwing a pot on the wheel
